what_happened: Re-derived the known-gap-register.md census directly from all 18 live docs/book-convention/*.md marker lines in the consuming repo: got 2 binding / 15 partially / 1 none-yet, exactly matching the register's existing 2/15/1 figure. The dispatch/seed report had described this as stale against a claimed '1/15/2' record truth; direct measurement caught this before it could be propagated into an incorrect fix during implementation.

Research report 02 resolved all six anchor targets, corrected the task description's ASCII renderings of the Unicode pointer arrow and em dash, and corrected the census claim (2/15/1 is already right), so the plan phase wrote concrete per-phase targets with no re-derivation.

check-extension-docs.sh Rule R (check_line_count_accuracy) is blocking and validates index-entries.json line_count against each context file's wc -l; every prose phase in this plan perturbs those counts. Resolved at plan time by giving index-entries.json a single exclusive owner phase (Phase 7) instead of letting four parallel-wave phases contend for it.

Mechanical re-verification of known-gap-register.md's 2/15/1 marker census, run against the consuming repo's live current HEAD (9b383116), found 19 decision files (not 18) with a 2/16/1 split -- a 19th decision (19-convention-versioning-and-lockstep.md) was added to the external repo after the task's own research cutoff. Re-verified against the research-cited commit a07ae5f instead (matching the plan's 'measured HEAD' intent) and confirmed 2/15/1 holds there exactly. Per the plan's explicit non-goal (no corpus-wide re-measurement, no correction to the 2/15/1 census), the header date/SHA was bumped to a07ae5f/2026-10-05 and the census left untouched; the further live-HEAD drift to 19 decisions is out of scope for this task.

Phase 5's verification heuristic (git diff | grep -c '^-.*2026-10-03' expected to equal 1) read 2 instead of 1: retargeting the three-decision anchor list in certificate-ledger-and-records.md lengthened that sentence enough to reflow the adjacent 'Every figure below was measured 2026-10-03 ... 7281c81' sentence onto a different line, which a line-based diff counts as a removed+re-added date line even though its literal content is byte-identical, just rewrapped. Confirmed via a full file diff that the measurement text itself was not altered; no second date was actually refreshed.

Caught a figure-consistency bug before committing: initially measured book-convention.md's slim-index line count against the consuming repo's live current HEAD (9b383116, 347 lines), which would have put README.md's figure one commit ahead of known-gap-register.md's deliberately-pinned a07ae5f (343 lines, matching the 2/15/1 census research already verified). Corrected README.md to cite the same a07ae5f/343-line measurement so both refreshed figures anchor to one consistent commit across the corpus.

While implementing the convention_version pin (research had found the record unversioned at the research-time commit a07ae5f), discovered the consuming repository's live HEAD had, in the interim, landed its OWN Decision 19 ('Convention versioning and lockstep', commit 989eb0c5) specifying exactly this mechanism: a '- **Convention version**: X.Y.Z' header line, a books-extension corpus-README declaration, and a non-blocking advisory comparison for the extension's own lag. Read Decision 19 in full and pinned convention_version to the LIVE value actually present (0.1.0-pre at commit d255518, re-confirmed immediately before writing, since the external repo was observed advancing mid-task) rather than the stale 'unversioned' sentinel the original research expected, and worded the README section's severity split (blocking record-vs-manual inside the consuming repo, advisory for the extension pin) to mirror Decision 19's own clause 4 rationale rather than inventing an independent one.
